evidence_gaps: The supplied evidence reports MISSING_RUNTIME_FORENSICS with generated_epoch 0 and no current runtime window.
No timestamped opportunity, quote, simulation, submission, confirmation or reconciliation records are available for either chain.
No realised money-weighted NET P&L by strategy and chain after trading fees, slippage, price impact, gas or priority fees, refundable-rent reconciliation and failed-attempt costs.
No opportunity-denominator, eligibility, participation or no-trade records proving that strategies act only on eligible positive-edge opportunities.
No stage-specific execution failure counts, costs, latency distributions or classification separating STRATEGY/MARKET loss from EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failure.
No out-of-sample or walk-forward results, drawdown, tail-loss, regime, asset-concentration or route-concentration analysis.
No quote-to-fill deterioration, stale-quote rate, revert or dropped-transaction rate, fill completeness or sellability-at-exit evidence.

Before any promotion: require fresh sanitised runtime evidence, reproducible per-trade all-in cost attribution, independent out-of-sample windows, positive aggregate money-weighted net P&L with a margin above estimation error, acceptable profit factor and drawdown, and bounded chain-specific execution failure rates.

proposals.downside_risk: Conservative thresholds may reduce observations, but inactivity is preferable to unsupported negative-edge execution.

evidence.detail: MarketFeatures.net_edge_bps subtracts fees, slippage, price impact and latency reserve; common eligibility also requires positive minimum net edge, liquidity, sellability and quote freshness.
Quote simulations are explicitly marked non-realised, promotion_evidence remains false and the executor has no signing or transaction-submission path.
Lifecycle decisions use money-weighted net profit and profit factor rather than win count, while zero eligible opportunities are not treated as failure.

proposals.expected_effect: Preserves fail-closed research and prevents raw win rate or quote-only gains from driving promotion.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 30 independent market windows per chain, including windows with no eligible opportunity and adverse-cost regimes.
proposals.rationale: These are durable governance properties aligned with net P&L and the rule that no trade is forced without executable edge.
proposals.shadow_test: Replay both chains with timestamped quotes and all-in costs. Confirm every eligible event has net_edge_bps above its threshold and that zero-edge or missing-cost events are rejected. Stop and mark failure if any eligible event has non-positive recomputed edge or creates promotion evidence.

proposals.downside_risk: A conservative edge model may reject profitable leader moves if the forward-return estimator is poorly calibrated.

evidence.detail: Entry requires deterioration and round-trip loss below configurable ceilings, but a loss below the ceiling is still negative edge and the calculation does not include estimated buy gas, exit gas, execution-failure reserve or a positive expected return.
Chain gas estimates exist for both sides, so an all-in shadow edge calculation can include EVM gas economics.
The BUY path catches Exception and continues without recording the failed stage or cause, preventing EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failures from being distinguished from STRATEGY/MARKET outcomes.

proposals.expected_effect: Fewer EVM entries with structurally negative all-in expectancy and usable attribution of quote, simulation, RPC, signing, broadcast, confirmation and balance-reconciliation failures.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 100 eligible EVM signals, 30 completed counterfactual round trips, coverage across two gas regimes, and enough failures to estimate stage-specific failure rates; otherwise continue SHADOW.
proposals.rationale: A maximum tolerable round-trip loss is a safety limit, not evidence of positive executable edge. Copying should require a conservative expected follower return to exceed buy gas, exit gas, DEX fees, impact, slippage, latency and failure-cost reserves.
proposals.shadow_test: For every leader BUY, record the contemporaneous forward-return estimate and deduct quoted round-trip deterioration, both-leg gas at effective fee conditions, price impact, slippage, latency and an empirically estimated failed-attempt cost. Admit only strictly positive stressed net edge. Compare skipped versus admitted forward outcomes without trading. Fail if admitted events have non-positive aggregate money-weighted net P&L, if any cost component is missing, or if failure stages cannot be classified separately from market loss.

proposals.downside_risk: Counterfactual exits may be biased if quotes are sampled after the decision or only when infrastructure succeeds.

evidence.detail: The adapter deliberately leaves current gross edge, liquidity and sellability at zero because stored leader events lack contemporaneous executable future-return evidence.
The Solana execution path estimates follower edge after current Jupiter round-trip loss, network fees, two-leg slippage reserve, latency reserve and a historical-return haircut.
LIVE swaps fail closed when route-level price impact is unavailable.
Refundable token-account rent is separated from economic trading cost and later reconciled.

proposals.expected_effect: Produces falsifiable Solana strategy evidence while preserving chain-specific priority-fee, impact, slippage, latency, rent and execution-failure economics.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 100 independent Solana signals, 30 policy-complete counterfactual exits, multiple congestion and liquidity regimes, and explicit accounting for every failed observation.
proposals.rationale: Solana safeguards are economically thoughtful, but the common SHADOW evidence pipeline cannot presently evaluate realised or counterfactual outcomes. Historical leader returns are not proof of current follower edge.
proposals.shadow_test: At decision time persist immutable Jupiter entry and immediate sell quotes, route impact, slippage tolerance, priority/base fees, rent status and latency. Requote exits under a predefined policy and include failed quote, simulation and submission attempts as EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE observations, while adverse prices after successful execution remain STRATEGY/MARKET outcomes. Fail on look-ahead data, missing sellability, missing impact, or non-positive aggregate money-weighted net P&L.
proposals.strategy: Solana leader-copy and common Strategy Lab signals

rejected_ideas.idea: Promote a strategy because quote simulations or historical leader win rate are positive.
rejected_ideas.reason: Neither proves durable money-weighted realised net P&L, and quote simulations explicitly are not promotion evidence.

rejected_ideas.idea: Increase slippage, impact limits or retry aggressiveness to raise trade count.
rejected_ideas.reason: This can convert execution protection into adverse selection and violates the requirement not to force trades.

rejected_ideas.idea: Treat all negative outcomes as strategy losses.
rejected_ideas.reason: RPC, quote, simulation, signing, broadcast, confirmation and reconciliation failures are EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failures and require separate attribution.

summary: Architecture-only review completed. The shared SHADOW framework correctly requires positive cost-adjusted edge and prevents simulated quotes from becoming promotion evidence. Solana has stronger chain-specific entry economics, including round-trip deterioration, network and priority fees, slippage, latency, impact and refundable-rent treatment. The EVM SiBot copy-entry path is weaker: its round-trip-loss ceiling can admit a negative-edge trade and does not deduct estimated buy and exit gas from an explicit executable-edge requirement. It also silently discards broad exceptions, obstructing separation of STRATEGY/MARKET losses from EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failures. Runtime forensics are absent, so no profitability, CANARY-readiness or LIVE-readiness claim is made.
